resources.string: I-OpenPressure %1$s iyatholakala. Usebenzisa i-%2$s.\n\nIkhasi lokulanda lizovuleka esipheqululini sakho. I-Android ifaka isibuyekezo kuphela uma sivela kunjiniyela ofanayo.
Asikho isiphequluli esitholakele sokuvula ikhasi lokulanda.
Cishe kanye ngosuku, i-OpenPressure ibuza i-GitHub ukuthi ikhona yini inguqulo entsha. Isicelo siqukethe inguqulo ye-app kuphela; azikho izilinganiso noma imininingwane yedivayisi ethunyelwayo.
Ukuhlola izibuyekezo kuxhumana ne-GitHub cishe kanye ngosuku ukuze kufunwe inguqulo entsha. Ungakuvala ku-%1$s → %2$s.
